verdict.rationale: Gitea's site states it is a self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Its public GitHub repository (go-gitea/gitea) points readers to build and development docs, and community users discuss its Go codebase internals, which corroborates that the source is readable. Missing for 10: a direct citation of the repository's LICENSE file or license metadata, since the MIT statement comes only from the marketing page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license.
See docs/build-setup.md for prerequisites and docs/development.md for setting up a local development environment, linting, and testing.
They cite migrations that go up but not down, a nonstandard web framework (go-macaron), too much logic in Go templates, and strange error reporting.
